commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
id
cat /etc/redhat-release
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
systemctl is-active sshd
ss -tlnp | grep ':22 '
sshd -T | grep -E '^(hostkey|hostcertificate) '
printf '%s\n' '--- effective config directives ---'
grep -RHE '^[[:space:]]*(HostKey|HostCertificate)[[:space:]]+' /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- current host public keys/certificates ---'
ls -l /etc/ssh/ssh_host_* 2>/dev/null || true
commands.error: The Antrieb managed cluster lease expired
